title.narrative: Immediate food assistance for the population of the 9 most-affected municipalities in Artemisa and Mayabeque provinces with emphasis on malnutrition prevention and prioritizing most vulnerable group.

description.narrative: The action plan for the CERF allocation is based on a life-saving strategy and will contribute to the immediate food assistance during the first month, covering 67% (20 days) of the needs to reach 349000 shock- affected people in the 9 most impacted municipalities (from Artemisa and Mayabeque). WFP provide in-kind food assistance (50g of rice, 30g of pulses and 30.66 g of vegetable oil per person/day) as a complement of the monthly food basket to support of Cuban authorities in preserving food security and nutrition in the 7 most- affected Artemisa´s municipalities:( Mariel; Güira de Melena; Alquizar; Artemisa; Bahia Honda; Guanajay; San Antonio) and the 2 most affected Mayabeque´s municipalities: Batabanó, Quivicán by the Hurricane Rafael shock.WFP also provide kitchen sets to the most -affected families in Artemisa province, in order to improve their cook and consumption capacity. To ensure timely assistance, WFP used food and non-food items already pre-positioned in the country. WFP Cuba requires a total of US$ 1,300,000.00 from the CERF for this operation, which represents 12.65% of the total WFP operational action plan for this emergency.
